## Summary In a `SegmentedStack`, an ordinary quad whose subject is the reifier of a reifier row held in a *different* layer is returned as an annotation of that reifier: `quads()` and `quads_for_pattern` do not yield it, `annotation_quads()` does, and the view records no read error. The same two rows sealed into *one* image read back as written (one ordinary quad, one reifier, no annotation). So how rows are split across layers changes the answer. ## Reproduction (purrdf `0d075201f`) Two images built with `SegmentedBuilder` (build limits sized to the rows; 4096-byte blocks, 32 records), stacked oldest first with `SegmentedStack::publish`, queried through `SegmentedStackSnapshot::query`: - image A: `push_reifier(, <<( )>>, None)` - images B1, B2: `push_quad( )`, `push_quad( )`, one each | stack | `quads()` | `quads_for_pattern(, , _)` | `reifier_quads()` | `annotation_quads()` | |---|---:|---:|---:|---:| | [A, B1, B2] | 0 | 0 | -- | 2 | | [B1, B2, A] | 0 | -- | 1 | -- | | [B1, B2] | 2 | -- | -- | -- | and in one image, ``'s reifier row with `push_quad(

)`, `quads()` is 0; with A's reifier subject changed to ``, it is 1. `read_error()` after the walks over [A, B1, B2] is `None`. Katamari's reproductions: `crates/katamari-query-purrdf/src/layers.rs` `reifier_subjects::an_ordinary_row_on_another_layers_reifier_is_read_as_an_annotation` and, end to end, `crates/katamari-query-purrdf/tests/query.rs` `a_claim_about_a_claim_reads_back_as_written_from_its_layers` (both pinned `should_panic` until this is fixed). ## Impact A claim about a claim asserts a triple whose subject is the earlier claim's reifier. Persisted as layers, that triple disappears from the ordinary stream and appears as an annotation, so a persisted graph's answers differ from the same data in one dataset. Katamari cannot persist its graph as segmented layers for a vault holding such claims until the stack classifies rows the same way whatever the layering. ## Expected A stack answers as the union of its layers' rows (less removals) would in one image: an ordinary quad stays ordinary regardless of which layer holds a reifier row for its subject.

title: Segmented stack reads an ordinary quad as an annotation when its subject is a reifier in another layer
